body:
This PR removes all instances of the old way of using InstantSearch.js:

- `createAlgoliaAgent()`
- `appId` and `apiKey`

`algoliasearch` is now a dev dependency.

## Changes

- Update source code
- Update documentation
- Update README
- Update demos
